title: Millrace Hartnett 验证收入
instruction:
您是 Hilde Ferreira，Millrace Systems 开发人员，拥有 Kilnbrook Media 音乐库背后的按播放版税管道。奥雷利奥·哈内特 (Aurelio Hartnett) 的抵押贷款承销商拒绝了他的自助特许权使用费报表，并希望获得经过认证的月度收入历史记录，以便有接近计算情况的人可以支持。 Bohdan Dunbar 在`Hartnett_verified_income_source.xlsx` 中汇总了游戏历史、评级材料、曲目和实体参考、验证要求以及 Kilnbrook 部分完成的验证收入模板。请使用该工作簿返回一个名为 `Hartnett_verified_income_certified.xlsx` 的已完成文件，该文件写入您开始使用的工作目录的顶层，并且完全使用该文件名。历史记录必须涵盖模板中提供的完整时期，并且必须显示在删除重试生成的比赛后哈特尼特实际赚取的收入；承销商不希望对有问题的月份进行平均、平滑或默默替换。
请按如下方式填写工作簿：(1) 在每个所需的日历月中填写一行，显示报表金额、更正金额、删除播放次数、通货膨胀金额以及模板的月份状态； (2) 将 Kilnbrook 提供的操作材料中的重试确定一致地应用于完整游戏群体，包括注释中记录的行级异常，并在重建收入时使用提供的有效汇率、跟踪所有权、支付实体和管辖区信息； (3) 完成比赛审核区域，以便从 Hartnett 收入中删除的每场比赛都可以追溯到其源事件和决策基础，而不符合所提供规则的比赛仍保留在收入中； (4) 通过识别标记的比赛和保留的相邻比赛，使 March 2019 示例可在不搜索完整导出的情况下进行审查，并准确说明为什么它们的结果不同； (5) 完成年度和全周期控制，以便与每月时间表和审查的游戏人口保持一致，而不是与任何预先存在的分析师检查保持一致； (6) 完成模板对英格兰和威尔士以及苏格兰的核实收入要求的比较，记录本工作簿是否满足所提供的每项要求，并注意两者之间的任何实质性差异；并 (7) 完成认证块
k 使用已经为管道所有者提供的措辞和截止日期，但保留模板为承销商或后来的审阅者保留的字段不变。将基本注释保留在一页纸上。它应该为同行评审者提供足够的信息来重现结果，包括重试测试、基于注释的异常的处理、如何在提供的材料中匹配标识符、3 月 2019 边界示例以及管辖结论的基础。请勿引入估算、外部费率或不受支持的个人详细信息。在返回工作簿之前，请确保其标签、总计、审核决定、管辖权声明和认证彼此一致，并且已完成的文件中没有出现明显的电子表格错误。

---

上述文件位于`references/`中：

- `references/Hartnett_verified_income_source.xlsx` — 包含线路级别播放历史记录、版税费率、曲目和实体参考、英格兰、威尔士和苏格兰的验证要求，以及 Kilnbrook Media 部分完成的验证收入工作簿。

将您完成的工作写入**当前工作目录的顶层**，使用以下文件名：
- `Hartnett_verified_income_certified.xlsx` — 完成经过认证的月度收入工作簿，包括游戏审查、控制、司法管辖区比较、认证和一页基础说明。 （使用确切的文件名将文件放置在工作目录的顶层。使用提供的 Kilnbrook 模板及其规定的输出词汇表。覆盖整个提供的时间段，保留源可追溯性，将模板保留字段留空，并将基本注释调整到一页打印页上。）

除了这些文件名之外，不会收集任何内容。在其他地方或以任何其他名称编写的正确文件得分为零。

sheets.name: Basis Note
rows:
Data basis: Play_History events were matched to Track_Register and Entity_Reference by trimming trailing spaces and comparing keys case-insensitively. Hartnett payable shares and effective-dated rates from Royalty_Rates were applied by play date, paying entity, jurisdiction and track classification. Statement earnings are the source-system amounts before correction; corrected earnings retain eligible plays only.

Retry test: sort by Play Time then Event ID. Remove a later event when normalized session, track, device and jurisdiction match the immediately preceding event and elapsed time is at most 30 seconds (inclusive). Notes override the test: “KEEP_OVERRIDE: separate genuine play” forces Keep; “REMOVE_OVERRIDE: confirmed retry” forces Remove. Removed events are listed once in Play Review with their source ID, timestamp and basis.

March 2019 boundary: EV-MAR-RETRY at 10:00:30 shares the normalized retry keys with EV-MAR-BASE at 10:00:00, so the inclusive 30-second boundary removes it. EV-MAR-KEEP at 10:01:01 is 31 seconds later, so it is retained; the one-second difference explains the opposing outcomes.

Controls: Monthly values are rounded to £0.01 for presentation; annual and full-period controls sum the monthly schedule. Inflation equals statement minus corrected, and status is Corrected if removed plays or positive inflation exists. The jurisdiction comparison reproduces every supplied England and Wales and Scotland requirement; both checklists are met, with Scotland’s additional explicit Scottish paying-entity requirement noted.

criteria.description: 所需的 XLSX 存在于确切的文件名下，并作为有效的工作簿打开。
criteria.evidence: 提交的文件元数据和工作簿包。
criteria.grader_hint: 确认 `Hartnett_verified_income_certified.xlsx` 存在于所需位置并且可以在不损坏包的情况下打开。

original.criterion: The required XLSX exists under the exact filename and opens as a valid workbook.
original.evidence: Submitted file metadata and workbook package.
original.grader_hint: Confirm `Hartnett_verified_income_certified.xlsx` is present at the required location and can be opened without package corruption.

criteria.description: 该工作簿包含所提供的 Kilnbrook 模板规定的所有输出表及其规定的名称。
criteria.evidence: 提交的工作簿工作表名称与源工作簿中的模板区域进行比较。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查工作簿表名称并确认源模板所需的每月计划、游戏审查、控制、管辖权比较、认证和基本注释区域是否存在。

original.criterion: The workbook contains all output sheets prescribed by the supplied Kilnbrook template, with their prescribed names.
original.evidence: Submitted workbook sheet names compared with the template areas in the source workbook.
original.grader_hint: Inspect workbook sheet names and confirm the monthly schedule, play review, controls, jurisdiction comparison, certification, and Basis Note areas required by the source template are present.

criteria.description: 每月计划包含源模板指定的完整验证期内每个日历月的一行，没有遗漏或重复的月份。
criteria.evidence: 源工作簿中的每月计划日期和验证期边界。
criteria.grader_hint: 根据提供的开始日期和结束日期生成包含月份序列，并将其与规范化日期后提交的月份列进行比较。

original.criterion: The monthly schedule contains exactly one row for every calendar month in the full verification period stated by the source template, with no omitted or duplicated month.
original.evidence: Monthly schedule dates and the verification-period boundaries in the source workbook.
original.grader_hint: Generate the inclusive month sequence from the supplied start and end dates and compare it with the submitted month column after normalizing dates.

criteria.description: 对于每个月，修正后的收入等于分配给该月的保留合格投注线的版税总和，每月 ±£0.01 以内。
criteria.evidence: 源播放线路、有效费率材料、所有权参考、例外说明以及提交的每月更正金额。
criteria.grader_hint: 应用资格和重试决定后，根据提供的行级别事实重新计算版税，按日历月分组，并以 ±£0.01 的容差比较每个提交的结果。

original.criterion: For every month, corrected earnings equal the sum of royalties on retained eligible play lines assigned to that month, within ±£0.01 per month.
original.evidence: Source play lines, effective rate material, ownership references, exception notes, and submitted monthly corrected amounts.
original.grader_hint: Recompute royalties from the supplied line-level facts after applying eligibility and retry decisions, group by calendar month, and compare each submitted result at a tolerance of ±£0.01.

criteria.description: 每个保留的合格游戏均使用为其播放日期、支付实体、司法管辖区、曲目分类和其他费率维度提供的适用版税费率，在每月四舍五入之前每行 ±£0.000001 范围内。
criteria.evidence: 播放历史记录、版税率材料、曲目寄存器、实体参考和提交的计算。
criteria.grader_hint: 在标准化文本键后加入提供的参考，为每个保留的合格游戏选择生效日期，并与提交的详细信息或重建的每月值进行比较。

original.criterion: Each retained eligible play uses the applicable supplied royalty rate for its play date, paying entity, jurisdiction, track classification, and other rate dimensions, within ±£0.000001 per line before monthly rounding.
original.evidence: Play history, royalty-rate material, track register, entity reference, and submitted calculations.
original.grader_hint: Join the supplied references after normalizing textual keys, select the effective-dated rate for each retained eligible play, and compare with submitted detail or reconstructed monthly values.

criteria.description: 除非行注释明确覆盖该结果，否则满足所提供的重试规则的所有播放均被排除在更正收益之外。
criteria.evidence: 按时间顺序排列的源播放线路、提供的重试策略、行注释、播放审核决策和更正的收益。
criteria.grader_hint: 按时间戳顺序重播确定性重试规则，并确认每个规则为正、未覆盖的事件都被标记为已删除，并且对修正收益的贡献为零。

original.criterion: All plays meeting the supplied retry rule are excluded from corrected earnings unless a row note explicitly overrides that outcome.
original.evidence: Chronological source play lines, supplied retry policy, row notes, play-review decisions, and corrected earnings.
original.grader_hint: Replay the deterministic retry rule in timestamp order and confirm every rule-positive, non-overridden event is marked removed and contributes zero to corrected earnings.

criteria.description: 不符合所提供的重试规则的比赛在符合条件时仍会包含在内，除非其行明确指出直接删除。
criteria.evidence: 源播放线路、重试策略、行注释、播放审核决策和更正收益。
criteria.grader_hint: 确认保留规则否定的符合条件的事件，除非适用的注释覆盖主要字段并指示删除。

original.criterion: Plays that do not meet the supplied retry rule remain included when otherwise eligible, unless their row notes explicitly direct removal.
original.evidence: Source play lines, retry policy, row notes, play-review decisions, and corrected earnings.
original.grader_hint: Confirm rule-negative eligible events are retained except where an applicable note overrides the main fields and directs removal.

criteria.description: 对于保留和删除例外，每个基于注释的异常都会按照注释指定的方向覆盖主要播放列。
criteria.evidence: 自由文本注释源游戏数据中的值和提交的游戏审核决策。
criteria.grader_hint: 枚举带有所提供的异常短语的所有行，并验证每个最终决策是否遵循注释而不是普通的自动结果。

original.criterion: Every note-based exception overrides the main play columns in the direction stated by the note, for both keep and remove exceptions.
original.evidence: Free-text Notes values in the source play data and submitted play-review decisions.
original.grader_hint: Enumerate all rows carrying the supplied exception phrases and verify that each final decision follows the note rather than the ordinary automated result.

criteria.description: 在大小写和尾随空格规范化之后，轨道、实体和其他提供的引用连接会成功，而不会拆分或丢失其他匹配的键。
criteria.evidence: 源标识符故意根据大小写或尾随空格和提交的计算而变化。
criteria.grader_hint: 通过修剪尾随空格并使用不区分大小写的匹配来规范相关文本键，然后确认所有设计的匹配都在正确的参考记录下做出贡献。

original.criterion: Track, entity, and other supplied reference joins succeed after case and trailing-space normalization, without splitting or losing otherwise matching keys.
original.evidence: Source identifiers deliberately varied by case or trailing whitespace and submitted calculations.
original.grader_hint: Normalize relevant text keys by trimming trailing whitespace and using case-insensitive matching, then confirm all designed matches contribute under the correct reference record.

criteria.description: 由所提供的规则指定为重试的 March 2019 比赛将被删除，而相邻的边界比赛将被保留。
criteria.evidence: 3月2019源事件，提供重试规则，并提交播放评论条目。
criteria.grader_hint: 找到源中内置的成对的 March 2019 边界事件，并验证确切的事件标识符和相反的最终决策。

original.criterion: The March 2019 play designated by the supplied rule as a retry is removed, while the neighbouring boundary play is retained.
original.evidence: March 2019 source events, supplied retry rule, and submitted play-review entries.
original.grader_hint: Locate the paired March 2019 boundary events built into the source and verify the exact event identifiers and opposing final decisions.

criteria.description: 基础注释准确地解释了为什么标记的 March 2019 游戏跨越了重试边界，而相邻的游戏却没有跨越重试边界。
criteria.evidence: 基础注释和相应的源事件字段。
criteria.grader_hint: 说明必须引用重大事件属性和界线比较，不能简单地标明一件事是重复的，另一件事是真实的。

original.criterion: The Basis Note precisely explains why the flagged March 2019 play crossed the retry boundary and why the neighbouring play did not.
original.evidence: Basis Note and the corresponding source event fields.
original.grader_hint: The explanation must cite the material event attributes and boundary comparison, not merely label one event duplicate and the other genuine.

criteria.description: 对于每个月，删除的播放计数等于该月中作为重试或注释引导删除而排除的源事件的数量，每个事件计数一次。
criteria.evidence: 来源事件、提交的游戏评论以及每月删除的游戏计数。
criteria.grader_hint: 派生已删除的事件标识符，按源播放月份对它们进行分组，并将精确的整数计数与每月计划进行比较。

original.criterion: For every month, the removed-play count equals the number of source events excluded as retries or note-directed removals in that month, with each event counted once.
original.evidence: Source events, submitted play review, and monthly removed-play counts.
original.grader_hint: Derive removed event identifiers, group them by source play month, and compare exact integer counts with the monthly schedule.

criteria.description: 每个月的通货膨胀金额等于报表收益减去修正收益，不存在因四舍五入而引入的负值，公差为±£0.01。
criteria.evidence: 提交的报表、更正和通货膨胀栏。
criteria.grader_hint: 每个月重新计算差异并在±£0.01进行比较；还检查不合理的负通胀值。

original.criterion: Each monthly inflation amount equals statement earnings minus corrected earnings, with no negative value introduced by rounding, at a tolerance of ±£0.01.
original.evidence: Submitted statement, corrected, and inflation columns.
original.grader_hint: Recalculate the difference for every month and compare at ±£0.01; also inspect for unjustified negative inflation values.

criteria.description: 月份状态使用模板提供的状态词汇来标识每个且仅具有至少一场被删除的比赛或正通货膨胀量的月份。
criteria.evidence: 每月计数、通货膨胀金额、状态和模板词汇。
criteria.grader_hint: 从提交的和独立重新计算的每月度量中得出预期状态，然后比较确切的允许状态标签。

original.criterion: The month status identifies every and only those months with at least one removed play or a positive inflation amount, using the status vocabulary supplied by the template.
original.evidence: Monthly counts, inflation amounts, statuses, and template vocabulary.
original.grader_hint: Derive the expected status from the submitted and independently recomputed monthly measures, then compare exact permitted status labels.

criteria.description: 每个删除的事件都会在播放审核区域中出现一次，并附有其源事件标识符、播放时间、最终决策和适用的决策依据。
criteria.evidence: 派生删除事件集并提交播放评论行。
criteria.grader_hint: 将完整的预期删除事件标识符集与审核区域进行比较，检查唯一性和填充的可追溯性字段。

original.criterion: Every removed event appears once in the play-review area with its source event identifier, play time, final decision, and applicable decision basis.
original.evidence: Derived removed-event set and submitted play-review rows.
original.grader_hint: Compare the complete expected removed-event identifier set with the review area, checking uniqueness and populated traceability fields.

criteria.description: 年度报表、更正的通货膨胀和移除的游戏控制等于其构成的每月价值的总和，货币的范围在 ±£0.01 范围内，计数的范围在 ±0 范围内。
criteria.evidence: 提交月度计划和年度控制。
criteria.grader_hint: 按日历年对月度值进行分组，并以 ±£0.01 比较年度资金总额，并准确计算移除游戏数。

original.criterion: Annual statement, corrected, inflation, and removed-play controls equal the sums of their constituent monthly values, within ±£0.01 for money and ±0 plays for counts.
original.evidence: Submitted monthly schedule and annual controls.
original.grader_hint: Group monthly values by calendar year and compare annual money totals at ±£0.01 and removed-play counts exactly.

criteria.description: 全周期报表、更正和通货膨胀控制等于±£0.01内相应的月度或年度总数，并且全周期移除播放计数精确调节。
criteria.evidence: 月度计划、年度控制、全周期控制。
criteria.grader_hint: 独立对整个周期求和，并比较 ±£0.01 处的货币字段和 ±0 处的计数。

original.criterion: Full-period statement, corrected, and inflation controls equal the corresponding monthly or annual totals within ±£0.01, and the full-period removed-play count reconciles exactly.
original.evidence: Monthly schedule, annual controls, and full-period controls.
original.grader_hint: Independently sum the complete period and compare money fields at ±£0.01 and the count at ±0.

criteria.description: 英格兰和威尔士的比较记录了所提供的验证要求，并根据每一项要求正确评估本工作簿。
criteria.evidence: 来源中的管辖权要求与提交的比较。
criteria.grader_hint: 将每项适用的英格兰和威尔士要求以及提交的合规结论与已完成的工作簿进行比较；不接受发明的要求。

original.criterion: The England and Wales comparison records the supplied verification requirements and correctly assesses this workbook against each one.
original.evidence: Jurisdiction requirements in the source and submitted comparison.

spec.professional_context: Hilde Ferreira is the Millrace Systems developer responsible for the royalty pipeline used by Kilnbrook Media. Bohdan Dunbar needs her to certify Aurelio Hartnett's historical royalty earnings for a mortgage review spanning the requirements used in England and Wales and in Scotland.
difficulty_sources: Applying one deterministic retry rule consistently across an enterprise-scale line-level play history
Respecting free-text row exceptions that override structured play fields
Normalizing case and trailing whitespace before joining complete reference material
Rebuilding monthly earnings and controls without propagating a residual analyst formula error
Producing auditable boundary reasoning for two nearly identical March 2019 events
Reconciling one workbook with verification requirements for England and Wales and Scotland

source_artifact.format: One text-extractable XLSX containing several semantically distinct source areas and a partially completed Kilnbrook verified-income template.
semantic_sources: A complete line-level play export for the full nine-year verification period, at approximately the scenario's enterprise-scale volume.
An effective-dated royalty rate schedule covering every combination required by the play data.
A track and ownership register that establishes Hartnett's payable share and track classification.
An entity and jurisdiction reference covering Kilnbrook's relevant paying entities and the named jurisdictions.
A verification-requirements source for England and Wales and for Scotland, including the local certification conventions.
A partially completed verified-income template containing the required output vocabulary, controls, certification fields, jurisdiction comparison, play review, and Basis Note area.

deterministic_business_logic.scope: Include play lines attributable to Hartnett through the supplied ownership register and otherwise eligible under the supplied play fields. Apply the effective royalty rate using play date, paying entity, jurisdiction, track classification, and all other rate dimensions present in the source.
deterministic_business_logic.key_matching: Reference keys are compared case-insensitively after removing trailing whitespace. Seed several valid joins whose only differences are letter case or trailing spaces across the play, track, entity, and rate material. All such keys have exactly one normalized match.
deterministic_business_logic.retry_rule: The operating material defines a retry as a later event that, after chronological ordering by timestamp and stable event identifier, has the same normalized session, track, device, and jurisdiction keys as the immediately preceding source event and occurs no more than a build-agent-chosen threshold of seconds later. The threshold must be a literal value not used in the prompt. This is an explicit inclusive boundary rule.
deterministic_business_logic.notes_override: The play export contains a free-text Notes column. Seed both directions of exception: wording that confirms a separate genuine play which must be kept despite satisfying the main retry test, and wording that confirms a retry which must be removed despite failing the main retry test. The supplied operating material states that these note instructions override the main columns. Use stable, recognizable phrases and include those phrases in the source policy or template legend.
deterministic_business_logic.monthly_values: Statement earnings are the source-system amounts before retry correction. Corrected earnings are the sum of payable royalties for retained events. Monthly removed-play count is the distinct count of excluded source event identifiers. Inflation is statement earnings minus corrected earnings. A month is assigned the template's correction status if and only if it has at least one removed event or positive inflation.
deterministic_business_logic.controls: Annual controls are sums of constituent monthly values. Full-period controls are sums of all months or annual controls. Money is rounded to currency precision only at the monthly presentation layer; reference calculations retain sufficient line-level precision.
deterministic_business_logic.certification: The template supplies the exact declaration wording, signer role, fixed as-of date, and field labels. Hilde Ferreira is the permitted pipeline-owner signer. Fields explicitly labeled for underwriter or later-reviewer use must remain blank.
deterministic_business_logic.jurisdictions: Supply complete, internally consistent verification checklists for England and Wales and for Scotland. Include common requirements and at least one substantive difference that can be faithfully compared from the supplied text. Both assessments must be decidable from the completed workbook without external legal research.

seeded_layout_defects.free_text_notes_override: Place per-row exception instructions in the Notes column while the ordinary structured fields continue to indicate the unmodified automated outcome. Include both keep and remove overrides.
seeded_layout_defects.residual_formula_error: Leave one prior analyst formula error in a non-authoritative legacy control cell within the partially completed template. Label its surrounding area as a prior or legacy analyst check through normal workplace context, while the authoritative source areas remain complete. The gold must ignore this cell and rebuild controls from play-level facts; the submitted workbook must not propagate the error.
seeded_layout_defects.case_and_trailing_space_keys: Vary a subset of otherwise valid join keys only by capitalization or trailing whitespace across source areas. Do not introduce missing, ambiguous, or many-to-many normalized matches.

boundary_case.march_2019: Create adjacent March 2019 events with the same normalized retry keys and no note override. One event falls exactly on the inclusive retry threshold and must be removed; the neighbouring event falls one second beyond the threshold and must be retained. Ensure their identifiers and timestamps are suitable for explicit discussion in the Basis Note.

required_outputs: Monthly fields for statement earnings, corrected earnings, removed-play count, inflation amount, and month status.
A play-review area with source event identifier, play time, final decision, and decision basis.
A comparison area for England and Wales and Scotland.
A certification block and explicitly reserved blank fields.
A Basis Note area configured for a one-page professional note.

authoring_plan.data_quality_boundaries: Inputs must otherwise be complete and mutually consistent. Do not add missing values, unexplained duplicate business records, mixed units, hidden graded data, merged-header traps, floating-point noise traps, conflicting dates, ambiguous effective periods, or any other standard input defect. Retry-like events are intentional business events to classify, not accidental duplicate rows.

gold_derivation.implementation: Use an offline reference script to read the workbook, normalize keys, construct unique reference joins, sort play events, apply the inclusive retry rule, apply Notes overrides, determine Hartnett eligibility and share, select effective rates, compute line royalties, and aggregate monthly, annual, and full-period outputs.
validation: Assert every normalized reference key has exactly one match.
Assert every source event receives exactly one final keep or remove decision.
Assert all note overrides reverse the ordinary rule outcome in their stated direction.
Assert the March 2019 boundary pair produces opposing expected decisions.
Assert corrected plus inflation equals statement earnings within one penny for every month.
Assert jurisdiction conclusions are supported by the supplied checklists.
Generate a reference workbook, render it offline, and walk every rubric item before setting the pass flag.

original_instruction:
You are Hilde Ferreira, the Millrace Systems developer who owns the per-play royalty pipeline behind Kilnbrook Media’s music library. Aurelio Hartnett’s mortgage underwriter has rejected his self-service royalty statements and wants a certified monthly earnings history that someone close to the calculation can stand behind. Bohdan Dunbar has assembled the play history, rate material, track and entity references, verification requirements, and Kilnbrook’s partially completed verified-income template in `Hartnett_verified_income_source.xlsx`. Please use that workbook to return one completed file named `Hartnett_verified_income_certified.xlsx`, written at the top level of the working directory you start in using exactly that filename. The history must cover the full period provided in the template and must show what Hartnett actually earned after retry-generated plays are removed; the underwriter does not want questionable months averaged, smoothed, or silently replaced. Please complete the workbook as follows: (1) populate the verified-income schedule with one line for every required calendar month, showing the statement amount, corrected amount, removed-play count, inflation amount, and the template’s month status; (2) apply the retry determination in Kilnbrook’s supplied operating material consistently to the full play population, including the row-level exceptions recorded in the notes, and use the supplied effective rates, track ownership, paying entity, and jurisdiction information when rebuilding earnings; (3) complete the play-review area so every play removed from Hartnett’s earnings is traceable to its source event and decision basis, while plays that do not meet the supplied rule remain in earnings; (4) make the March 2019 example reviewable without searching the full export by identifying the flagged play and the neighbouring play that was retained, and state precisely why their outcomes differ; (5) complete the annual and full-period controls so they reconcile to the monthly schedule and the reviewed play population rather than to any pre-existing analyst check; (6) complete the template’s comparison of the verified-income requirements for England and Wales and for Scotland, recording whether this workbook meets each supplied requirement and noting any substantive difference between the two; and (7) complete the certification block using the wording and as-of date already provided for the pipeline owner, but leave fields reserved by the template for the underwriter or a later reviewer untouched. Keep the Basis Note to one printed page. It should give a peer reviewer enough information to reproduce the result, including the retry test, the treatment of note-based exceptions, how identifiers were matched across the supplied material, the March 2019 boundary example, and the basis for the jurisdiction conclusions. Do not introduce estimates, external rates, or unsupported personal details. Before returning the workbook, make sure its labels, totals, review decisions, jurisdiction statements, and certification agree with one another and that no visible spreadsheet error has been carried into the completed file.

---

The files referred to above are in `references/`:

- `references/Hartnett_verified_income_source.xlsx` — Contains the line-level play history, royalty rates, track and entity references, verification requirements for England and Wales and Scotland, and Kilnbrook Media's partially completed verified-income workbook.

Write your finished work to the **top level of the current working directory**, using exactly these filenames:

- `Hartnett_verified_income_certified.xlsx` — Completed certified monthly earnings workbook, including the play review, controls, jurisdiction comparison, certification, and one-page Basis Note. (Place the file at the top level of the working directory using the exact filename. Use the supplied Kilnbrook template and its prescribed output vocabulary. Cover the entire supplied period, retain source traceability, leave template-reserved fields blank, and fit the Basis Note to one printed page.)

Nothing outside those filenames is collected. A correct file written anywhere else, or under any other name, scores zero.
